1.consolidated_definition: Planta silvestre parecida a la berenjena, cuyo fruto no es agradable. Su tronco lo usan de patrón para injertos de la berenjena comestible.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Wild plant resembling the eggplant, whose fruit is unpalatable. Its trunk is used as a pattern for grafting edible eggplants.
